title: CriticSearch: Fine-Grained Credit Assignment for Search Agents via a Retrospective Critic

rs.key_step: 冻结critic用GT与完整轨迹回顾判断每次search好坏，将非负turncredit按每trajectory正分总和归一，再与终局groupadv混合。
rs.why_non_obvious: 训练可用hindsight privileged信息，但它是judge监督而非干预确定的search价值。
rs.trigger_condition: When sparse outcome rewards hide redundant searches, use a privileged retrospective critic to distribute turn-level credit.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When sparse outcome rewards hide redundant searches, use a privileged retrospective critic to distribute turn-level credit.

signatures.information: GT答案、完整search轨迹/返回信息、冻结同scale instructcritic
signatures.operation: binary good/bad→按trajectorysum归一→与groupmean/std终局adv线性混合
signatures.failure_boundary: 7B MuSiQue19.4低于StepSearch22.6；Good信用非负且Bad为0，不保证bad动作负总adv；search任务与短horizon为主。

relevance.how: 直接turn级credit混合，可改造crop轨迹但需可靠critic。
用回顾上下文识别重复无用调用。
